rows.en: Where do you live?
I have been living here for a year.
Here is a book about this country.
It is a very new book.
I would like to live there.
Today I have to work.
What a big job!
But I want to tell you something.
What do you want to say?
I am here to get it done.
My friend is here right now.
What is he doing?
He is looking at a book.
What is he thinking about?
He is thinking about a new job.

rows.ru: Это мой первый день в городе.
rows.en: This is my first day in the city.
I have been here an hour already.
I see a big new city.
This word I already know.

rows.ru: После работы я думаю о жизни.
rows.en: After work I think about life.
When do you work?
I have a lot of work today.
And when do you see your friends?
Only after work.
Right now I have no time.
Where is the key?
It is lying in the kitchen.
I have been sitting here for an hour.
We live on the first floor.
The stairs are over there, behind the wall.
Here is a chair, and here is an armchair.
The bed is by the wall.
The mirror is big and new.
A book is lying on the floor.
Our courtyard is very big.
We are having repairs done at the moment.
The furniture is in the kitchen already.
The cupboard is big and clean.
The fence is new too.
And the glass is clean already.

rows.ru: Я одеваюсь и иду на работу.
rows.en: I get dressed and go to work.
What did you put on today?

rows.ru: Это новое, но не очень красивое.
rows.en: It is new, but not very nice.

rows.ru: Я ношу это только на работе.
rows.en: I only wear it at work.
After work I will take it off.
Here are my clothes and my shoes.
The suit is new and very smart.
Where is my tie?
It is in the jacket pocket.
I will put on the suit and the tie.
This dress is very beautiful.
And the coat and the jacket?
The ring is beautiful too.
Put on the shirt and the jacket.
A T-shirt is fashion too.
